research_question: What is the short-term effect (<12 months post-intervention) of child-feeding interventions, compared with no-intervention control, on children's vegetable intake?
treatment_label: Child-feeding intervention (e.g. repeated exposure, parent feeding-practice training, rewards/modelling, nutrition education targeting feeding)
outcome_description: Children's vegetable intake measured within 12 months of intervention end, by any quantitative measure (grams consumed, servings/day, portions, frequency of intake, weighed plate waste, 24-h recall, food frequency questionnaire, parent- or child-reported vegetable consumption, or vegetable acceptance/consumption at a test meal).
positive_direction: A positive Hedges g means children receiving the feeding intervention consumed MORE vegetables than no-intervention controls at short-term follow-up.
search_queries: child feeding intervention vegetable intake randomized controlled trial
repeated exposure vegetable consumption children experiment
parent feeding practices nutrition education trial children vegetable intake outcome
inclusion_criteria: Study involves children (infancy through adolescence) and delivers some form of feeding, parent-feeding, or child nutrition intervention
Reports some quantitative measure of vegetable intake, consumption, or acceptance (alone or within fruit-and-vegetable measures)
Includes a comparison group that received no intervention, usual care, waitlist, or minimal/attention control
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, editorial, commentary, opinion piece, protocol, or purely theoretical paper)
No comparison between an intervention condition and a control condition (e.g. single-arm pre-post only)
No quantitative outcome data usable for an effect size (no means+SDs, t/F values, proportions, or odds ratios reported or derivable)
Reports only long-term follow-up data collected 12 months or more after the intervention ended, with no short-term (<12 month) vegetable intake measure
Completely unrelated to child feeding or children's vegetable intake
moderators_to_extract: Intervention type (repeated exposure, reward/modelling, parent training, multicomponent education)
Outcome measurement method (objective weighed intake vs self/parent report)
Intervention duration and length of follow-up (weeks)
effect_size_note: Pool as a standardized mean difference (Hedges g-corrected SMD) because studies use heterogeneous vegetable intake metrics (grams, servings, frequency scores). Where a study reports both vegetable-only and combined fruit-and-vegetable intake, prefer the vegetable-only measure. Use only the earliest post-intervention assessment occurring less than 12 months after intervention end; exclude ≥12-month follow-up data.
